ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled TaskCache Change by Uncommon Program
ruleDefinitions.description: Monitor the creation of a new key under 'TaskCache' when a new scheduled task is registered by a process that is not svchost.exe, which is suspicious

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Schedule\\\\TaskCache\\\\.*") AND  NOT ((registry_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\UpdateOrchestrator.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SoftwareProtectionPlatform\\\\SvcRestartTask\\\\Index.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Flighting\\\\OneSettings\\\\RefreshCache\\\\Index.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\TiWorker\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\svchost\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\ngen\\\.exe$") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Schedule\\\\TaskCache\\\\Tasks\\\\\\{B66B135D\\-DA06\\-4FC4\\-95F8\\-7458E1D10129\\}.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Schedule\\\\TaskCache\\\\Tree\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\\\\.NET\\ Framework\\\\\\\.NET\\ Framework\\ NGEN.*"))) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\Integration\\Integrator\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\Integration\\Integrator\.exe") OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec\.exe" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Schedule\\\\TaskCache\\\\Tree\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PLA\\\\Server\\ Manager\\ Performance\\ Monitor\\\\.*")) OR process_path = "System" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\RuntimeBroker\.exe" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Dropbox\\Update\\DropboxUpdate\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Dropbox\\Update\\DropboxUpdate\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate\\\.exe$"))
